l2d_voice#2.Text: 是那样没错啦……茉幌，你有什么点子吗？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_10_adv_script_millsage_004_1_01__adv_voice_millsage_004_1_01_121
l2d_voice#2.Text: 就是你，说・你・呢！ 那个看着像只垂头丧气小狗一样的家伙！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_11_adv_voice_millsage_004_1_05_090_a79920fe
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我们5人，就是millsage！ 差不多该让音乐响起来了吧！
